api_types.name: VariantAutoscaling
api_types.doc: VariantAutoscaling is the Schema for the variantautoscalings API. It represents the autoscaling configuration and status for a model variant.

fields.name: Spec
fields.doc: Spec defines the desired state for autoscaling the model variant.

fields.name: Status
fields.doc: Status represents the current status of autoscaling for the model variant.

api_types.name: VariantAutoscalingConfigSpec
api_types.doc: VariantAutoscalingConfigSpec holds the optional tuning fields for a VariantAutoscaling. It is extracted as a standalone embeddable type so that higher-level controllers (e.g. KServe) can inline it without duplicating field definitions.

fields.name: VariantCost
fields.doc: VariantCost specifies the cost per replica for this variant (used in saturation analysis).

api_types.name: VariantAutoscalingList
api_types.doc: VariantAutoscalingList contains a list of VariantAutoscaling resources.

fields.name: Items
fields.doc: Items is the list of VariantAutoscaling resources.

api_types.name: VariantAutoscalingSpec
api_types.doc: VariantAutoscalingSpec defines the desired state for autoscaling a model variant.

fields.name: ScaleTargetRef
fields.doc: ScaleTargetRef references the scalable resource to manage. This follows the same pattern as HorizontalPodAutoscaler.

fields.name: ModelID
fields.doc: ModelID specifies the unique identifier of the model to be autoscaled.

fields.name: MinReplicas
fields.doc: MinReplicas is the lower bound on the number of replicas for this variant. A value of 0 enables scale-to-zero when the model is idle. Defaults to 1, preserving existing behavior for VAs that omit this field.

fields.name: MaxReplicas
fields.doc: MaxReplicas is the upper bound on the number of replicas for this variant. The autoscaler will never scale beyond this value regardless of load.

fields.name: VariantAutoscalingConfigSpec
fields.doc: VariantAutoscalingConfigSpec holds optional tuning fields that integrators can embed.

markers: +kubebuilder:validation:XValidation:rule="!has(self.minReplicas) || self.minReplicas <= self.maxReplicas",message="minReplicas must be less than or equal to maxReplicas"

api_types.name: VariantAutoscalingStatus
api_types.doc: VariantAutoscalingStatus represents the current status of autoscaling for a variant, including the current allocation, desired optimized allocation, and actuation status.

fields.name: DesiredOptimizedAlloc
fields.doc: DesiredOptimizedAlloc indicates the target optimized allocation based on autoscaling logic.

fields.name: Actuation
fields.doc: Actuation provides details about the actuation process and its current status.

fields.name: Conditions
fields.doc: Conditions represent the latest available observations of the VariantAutoscaling's state +patchMergeKey=type +patchStrategy=merge +listType=map +listMapKey=type

api_types.name: OptimizedAlloc
api_types.doc: OptimizedAlloc describes the target optimized allocation for a model variant.

fields.name: LastRunTime
fields.doc: LastRunTime is the timestamp of the last optimization run.

fields.name: Accelerator
fields.doc: Accelerator is the type of accelerator for the optimized allocation. Deprecated: This field is deprecated and will be removed in a future version. Use node selector or node affinity from scale target instead.

fields.name: NumReplicas
fields.doc: NumReplicas is the number of replicas for the optimized allocation. nil means no optimization decision has been made yet.

api_types.name: ActuationStatus
api_types.doc: ActuationStatus provides details about the actuation process and its current status.

fields.name: Applied
fields.doc: Applied indicates whether the actuation was successfully applied.

operator_config.name: VAScaleTargetKey
operator_config.doc:
VAScaleTargetKey is the index field name for looking up VariantAutoscalings by their scale target.
The index value is a composite key in the format "Namespace/APIVersion/Kind/Name"
(e.g., "default/apps/v1/Deployment/my-app") to uniquely identify scale targets across namespaces
and avoid collisions between different resource types and API versions.
